description: Modal dialog for browsing and adding widgets to a dashboard, with category sidebar filtering, text search, and grid display of available widgets from an IWidgetRegistry. Renders on TmModal (dialog role, focus trap, Escape, bottom sheet on mobile).

parameters.name: WidgetRegistry
parameters.description: Registry of the widgets the host offers; null renders an empty selector.

parameters.name: ExistingWidgets
parameters.description: Ids of the widgets already on the dashboard — single-instance ones among them cannot be added again.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Raised when the user activates an addable widget card.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the selector should close (Escape, close button, Done, backdrop).

examples.title: Widget selector in a dashboard
examples.code:
<TmWidgetSelector WidgetRegistry="WidgetRegistry"
                  ExistingWidgets="@existingWidgetIds"
                  OnSelect="OnWidgetSelected"
                  OnClose="() => showSelector = false" />
